triggers.name: new_event
triggers.title: New event
triggers.help: Fetches events created after specified time

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Fetches event created since the given date/time. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

input.name: type
input.label: Type
input.hint: If left empty, all types of event will be picked

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Namely action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Namely connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

input.name: content
input.label: Post Message
input.hint: Message to post

input.name: file
input.label: File URL
input.hint: URL of the file to upload

actions.name: get_profile
actions.title: Get employee profile details by ID
actions.description: Get employee profile details in Namely

input.name: id
input.label: Profile ID
input.hint: Unique profile ID

input.name: id
input.label: Post ID
input.hint: Enter ID of the post to comment. Click at the date/time shown adjacent to the post. 'Post ID' can be found at the end of URL.

actions.name: search_profile
actions.title: Search people profiles
actions.help: If Profile email is mentioned, other fields will be ignored and search will be carried out based on Profile email only. Maximum of 50 search results are returned.

input.name: reports_to
input.label: Reports to
input.hint: ID of the profile to whom other profiles report. Click on People and select the required profile. ID can be found in the URL.

input.name: user_status
input.label: User status
input.hint: Valid values are active and inactive . Inactive user status returns pending profiles also

actions.name: update_profile
actions.title: Update people profile
actions.help: Update people profile using profile ID.

input.name: id
input.label: Profile ID
input.hint: Click on People and select the required profile. ID can be found in the URL.

input.name: job_title
input.label: Job title
input.hint: Enter either exact case sensitive job title or job ID

input.name: job_change_reason
input.label: Job change reason
input.hint: Valid values are New Hire, Salary Change, Promotion, Transfer

input.name: gender
input.label: Gender
input.hint: Valid values are Male, Female, Not specified

input.name: marital_status
input.label: Marital status
input.hint: Valid values are Single, Married, Civil Partnership, Separated, Divorced

input.name: user_status
input.label: User status
input.hint: Valid values are active, inactive, pending

input.name: image
input.label: Image ID
input.hint: Enter valid image ID
